points.point: A measurement method in the Vault is a defined procedure for obtaining a metric; GFM324 lists multiple TRP measurement procedures that are either accurate or a controlled overestimate.
points.label: partial
points.why: defines method generally and mentions TRP grids, but not accurate vs controlled-overestimate TRP procedures

points.point: The choice of measurement procedure depends on the available test setup, measurement equipment and measurement time.
points.label: covered
points.why: states TRP choice depends on setup, equipment, and time

points.point: Which OTA antenna test solution (test system / chamber) can be used is method- and test-case-dependent — not every solution covers every conformance test.
points.label: partial
points.why: lists OTA chamber/test-system choices, but does not clearly say coverage varies by test case and not all solutions cover all tests

points.point: The metric prescribed by the method is explicit in test procedures, e.g. OTA emission measurement must use TRP with True RMS detection.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions metric handling such as EIRP/TRP/co-location, but omits OTA emission TRP with True RMS detection

points.point: Instrument and option selection plus pre-test calibration (K544, attenuation/antenna-gain tables for cable, antenna and OTA losses) are part of the measurement-method decision.
points.label: covered
points.why: covers analyzer software options and K544 OTA calibration for cable/antenna/OTA losses

points.point: EEIRP is an example of a spatially defined measurement method/metric: the average of EIRP measurements over an upper hemisphere with elevation-specific limits.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention EEIRP or upper-hemisphere averaging

points.point: The Vault treats a missing measurement method as a reason a product/performance claim cannot be validated or compared.
points.label: missing
points.why: does not say missing measurement method makes claims unverifiable or incomparable

points.point: Option-level product questions are explicitly deferred to official documents when the measurement method is unknown (e.g. CMX-KA401 latency measurement method).
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention deferral of CMX-KA401 latency method to official documents
